name: The Sheiling
accommodation: En-suite doubles, a double with private bathroom and an en-suite twin
beachAccess: Photos show a view down to the beach from the B&B
boardStorage: Free secure lock-up bike storage in the garage
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast included, guest lounge, sea-view garden, bike storage, EV charger in village
overview: The Sheiling is a bed and breakfast in Melvich on the north coast, looking down towards the beach. It has en-suite double and twin rooms, a guest lounge and a garden with sea views. Strathy Point is a few minutes' drive away, and there is an EV charger in the village.
surfTripFit: It overlooks the beach at Melvich, and the lock-up garage could suit kit storage (ask first).
